$$
\operatorname{csc}⁡x=\operatorname{csc}⁡(x+2n\pi ).

$$

Therefore, if $\operatorname{csc}⁡x=\sqrt{5},$ then $\operatorname{csc}⁡(x-22\pi )=\sqrt{5}.$
